study_context_population.organization_type: not reported for a mission; author affiliation is academic.
study_context_population.project_maturity: Prototype demonstration using selected real COTS subsystem data.
study_context_population.context_notes: The modeled CubeSat system contains Antenna System, TRXVU, OBC, and EPS, each represented by aggregate attributes used in budget calculations.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Formally model and automate/facilitate CubeSat budget calculation so a builder can screen COTS component combinations against CubeSat constraints.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_and_abstraction: The boundary is a CubeSat Nanosatellite System represented by selected subsystems (Antenna System, TRXVU, OBC, EPS) and their aggregate physical/power attributes. The abstraction excludes detailed subsystem physics, full EPS behavior, and comprehensive budget categories.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: Author states the budget set is not comprehensive; the model is a proof-of-concept for selected budgets and basic I/O mechanisms.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Users need component attributes and budget thresholds (mass, volume, height, power). Detailed behavioral knowledge is minimized because OPM exposes a conceptual process model, generated OPL text, and executable calculations from simple inputs.

key_artifact_quotes.quote: The purpose of this work is two-fold: (1) formally modeling the budget calculating process, and (2) using the model to automate and facilitate this process.
The Budget Quantifying process is further refined ... into four subprocesses
OPCloud has an animated execution feature

generality_reuse_mechanism_v1_1_reasonin.rationale: The model is a generic CubeSat budget-calculation workflow/tool, not a specific mission model. It uses high-level subsystem/attribute abstractions and limited behavior focused on budget checks, and the author claims applicability to CubeSat builders and global CubeSat processes. Do not code template because OPM templates/stereotypes are only mentioned as general OPM features, not used in the demonstrated model.

evidence.quote: for automating the process of budget calculation - mass, volume, power, and energy - for CubeSat nanosatellites based on user input which can be iteratively finetuned to fit the CubeSat limitations
To help a Nanosatellite Builder find the most suitable components to build a nanosatellite
evidence.location: Section 4, Automating the Budget Calculating Process

evidence.quote: this work is not meant to be comprehensive in this regard, but rather to use some of the budget calculations to demonstrate a tool
standardizing and formulating global CubeSats processes and systems

implementation_steps_reported.description: Create the level-0 OPM System Diagram with Budget Calculating, Nanosatellite Builder, CubeSat Nanosatellite System, budget outputs, and Component Selection state.
implementation_steps_reported.inputs: CubeSat system concept and budget outputs
implementation_steps_reported.completion_criteria: Main process and value to beneficiary expressed.

implementation_steps_reported.description: Refine Budget Calculating into Budget Quantifying and Decision Making using OPM in-zooming.
implementation_steps_reported.completion_criteria: Budget calculations and accept/reject decision separated.

implementation_steps_reported.description: Unfold CubeSat Nanosatellite System into selected subsystems and unfold each subsystem into computational attributes.
implementation_steps_reported.outputs: Antenna, TRXVU, OBC, and EPS attribute objects
implementation_steps_reported.completion_criteria: Attributes such as mass, dimensions, and power are available as inputs.

implementation_steps_reported.description: Define budget thresholds and computational aliases; attach JavaScript code to computational budget processes.
implementation_steps_reported.outputs: Executable Height, Volume, Mass, and Power Budget Calculating processes
implementation_steps_reported.completion_criteria: Processes return budget values or Error when thresholds are exceeded.

implementation_steps_reported.description: Execute/animate the OPCloud model with component data and observe output budgets and Component Selection state.
implementation_steps_reported.inputs: Direct, runtime, simulated, or Excel-supported inputs; demonstrated with ISISPACE data
implementation_steps_reported.outputs: Budget values, accepted/not-accepted state, visual token flow
implementation_steps_reported.completion_criteria: Candidate components accepted or rejected based on budget checks.

implementation_pathway_tailoring.mapping_to_systems_engineering_activitie: Maps to early concept/component selection and budget compliance checking. No SRR, PDR, CDR, integration, test, or operations gate mapping is reported.
implementation_pathway_tailoring.handoffs: User-entered component data flow into computational processes; budget outputs flow into Decision Making and Component Selection state. No cross-role handoff beyond builder/modeler is reported.

named_tools_and_languages: Python and MATLAB connection capabilities mentioned as OPCloud capabilities, not used in demonstrated model
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_data_flow: Builder/modeler enters component attributes into OPCloud OPM objects; computational OPM processes read attributes through aliases; embedded JavaScript calculates budgets and writes budget objects; Decision Making reads budgets/thresholds and changes Component Selection state; OPCloud animates token flow and can optionally exchange data with Excel.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity_evidence: OPM links and OPCloud-generated OPL keep diagrams and textual statements synchronized; executable computational objects use aliases to connect model elements to code.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: not reported beyond early component-selection support
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_limitations: not reported explicitly; extractor notes dependency on OPCloud/OPM computational extensions and no published model package.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: OPCloud, OPM, and a JavaScript snippet are described; no repository, model file, full code, scripts, or reusable package is reported.

eps_verification_specific.eps_elements_other: EPS is represented through EPSP, height, length, width, and mass attributes; no solar panel, battery, power-conditioning/distribution, degradation, fault-protection, or EPS modes are modeled in detail.
eps_verification_specific.eps_requirements_represented_and_links: Budget thresholds for mass, volume, height, and power are linked to calculation processes and the Component Selection accept/reject state. These are budget constraints rather than formal EPS requirements.
eps_verification_specific.evidence_integrated_into_model: Thresholds, budget outputs, computation code, and accept/error states are modeled in OPCloud, not just documented separately.
eps_verification_specific.eps_relevance_caveat: The mechanism is system-budget verification and includes EPS as one input; it is not a dedicated EPS verification procedure model.

ivv_integration_level.rationale: The strongest defensible IVV integration level is executable model-based budget/threshold checking inside the OPM/OPCloud model. The paper shows model execution, threshold checks, and accept/error state changes, but not formal EPS verification artifacts, trace-linked test procedures, SIL/HIL, or a separate simulation-in-the-loop verification environment.

evidence.quote: returns the calculated value if it is less or equal to the predefined threshold or "Error" message otherwise
Decision Making subprocess ... considers all output objects to decide whether to accept the current configuration or not
There are cases where the proposed components do not comply with the system limitations ... yielded an "Error" value in the Volume Budget object

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: The model produced budget values and accepted/error outcomes for the illustrated component set; no improvement effect size is reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Demonstration uses one data set and partial code; automation may reflect a prototype implementation rather than general MBSE effectiveness.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.reliability_subtype_rationale: Automation/decision-support claim, not a reliability claim.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Rapid budget screening can help select more reliable and compatible COTS component combinations for a CubeSat.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: The paper asserts maintainability/consistency benefits; no change experiment or traceability audit is provided.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.reliability_subtype_rationale: The claim concerns keeping the model/system coherent, consistent, and synchronized.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.traceability_to_deliverables_or_decision: Budget outputs and Component Selection state provide model-derived decision support for accepting/rejecting a candidate component set. No project deliverables, assurance cases, milestone decisions, or management reports are reported.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.evaluation_criteria: Budget values must be less than or equal to predefined thresholds; otherwise the output becomes Error and the component selection remains/not-accepted.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.model_derived_performance_indicators_or_: Height Budget, Volume Budget, Mass Budget, Power Budget, and Component Selection accepted/not-accepted state; these are design indicators, not management ROI metrics.

gap_mapping_notes.practical_implementation_pathway: OPM model-building and execution steps are shown and evaluated with real component data.
gap_mapping_notes.toolchain_fragmentation_interoperability: Excel and MATLAB connections are mentioned as capabilities; no evaluated multi-tool interoperability solution is presented.
gap_mapping_notes.lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori: CubeSat standard constraints and COTS modularity motivate the budget calculator.
gap_mapping_notes.governance_project_deliverables_roi: Budget outputs link to component-selection decisions, but governance/ROI evidence is missing.
gap_mapping_notes.newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati: No agile, distributed, NewSpace, or rapid-iteration project process is addressed.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Shows how an OPM model can represent a CubeSat budget-calculation workflow with system/subsystem decomposition, aggregate attributes, and executable budget processes while requiring mainly component data and thresholds rather than detailed behavior.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Claims automation, decision support, consistency, and possible reliability/compatibility benefits; evidence is strongest for executable calculation and weak for outcome effects such as time savings or reliability.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: Provides budget threshold checks and animated execution before physical build, but no formal EPS verification procedure, test-case, matrix, SIL/HIL, or integration-test model.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: Budget calculations are not comprehensive and are used to demonstrate a tool.
Only basic input/output mechanisms are treated; advanced methods are beyond scope.
More attributes can be added to make the model more comprehensive.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No quantitative baseline for effort/schedule/reliability claims.
No EPS-specific behavior, architecture, or V&V evidence beyond aggregate EPS attributes and power budget input.
No lifecycle gates, governance, physical test, integration, or flight evidence.

synthesis_consistency.lineage_consistency_notes: Treat as an OPM/OPCloud executable-budget-calculator paper, not as a SysML EPS reference model or verification-procedure paper. It may overlap conceptually with non-MBSE MATLAB CubeSat budget-calculation tools discussed in related work.
synthesis_consistency.confidence_reason: Method and artifacts are clear, but outcome evidence, full code/model availability, venue details, and some figure-derived numbers are limited.

repair_notes: Add mission-agnostic architecture to generality/reuse mechanism; do not add template despite background mention of OPM templates.
Downgrade IVV integration level from simulation-in-the-loop to executable/model-based checks for a more conservative v1.1 coding.
Do not code EPS reliability; reliability support is system-level/component-selection and model-consistency only.
v1_1_subagent_review.normalization_note: Per-paper subagent patches were applied. For reliability_subtype structured summaries, not applicable is retained at claim level but omitted from aggregate values when substantive subtypes exist.
